description: Peeli sarson are small yellow seeds commonly used in tantra and shakti pujas. Inka prayog nakaratmak urja ko door karne ke liye hota hai.
havanUse: Releases pungent aromatic smoke when burned, believed to clear the atmosphere of negative vibrations.
spiritualBenefit: Removes black magic, evil eye, and creates a protective shield around the worshiper.
ayurvedicBenefit: Helps in treating digestive disorders and joint pains.
scientificNote: Burning mustard seeds releases allyl isothiocyanate, which acts as a mild fumigant and antibacterial agent.
precaution: Can cause mild eye irritation if the smoke is inhaled directly.

description: Haldi is a yellow-colored root, highly sacred in Hinduism. Ye shubh karyon aur vivah aadi mein prayog hoti hai.
havanUse: Offered as whole dried roots (khadi haldi) or powder. Emits a distinct earthy aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts prosperity, represents purity, and invokes the blessings of Jupiter (Guru) and Goddess Baglamukhi.
ayurvedicBenefit: Highly anti-inflammatory, boosts immunity, and purifies blood.
scientificNote: Contains curcumin, which is known for its strong antioxidant and antibacterial properties.
precaution: None

description: Guggul is a resin extracted from the Mukul myrrh tree. Iski sugandh devtaon ko bahut priya hoti hai.
havanUse: Produces a dense, sweet, and earthy smoke when burned on hot coals or cow dung cakes.
spiritualBenefit: Purifies the environment, appeases deities, and aids in deep meditation.
ayurvedicBenefit: Lowers cholesterol, reduces joint pain (arthritis), and promotes weight loss.
scientificNote: Guggulsterones in the resin have lipid-lowering properties.
precaution: Use in well-ventilated areas due to dense smoke.

description: Loban is a fragrant resin from the Boswellia or Styrax trees. Ye ghar ki shuddhi aur shanti ke liye jalaya jata hai.
havanUse: Melts and produces a thick, sweet, and uplifting fragrance that lingers for hours.
spiritualBenefit: Drives away evil spirits, creates a divine atmosphere, and increases focus.
ayurvedicBenefit: Relieves respiratory issues like asthma and bronchitis, calms the nervous system.
scientificNote: Burning frankincense activates ion channels in the brain to alleviate anxiety and depression.
precaution: May trigger asthma if used in excess in a closed room.

description: A hairy root resembling dreadlocks, found in the Himalayas. Ye dimag ko shanti pradan karne wali divya aushadhi hai.
havanUse: Burns slowly with an earthy, musky, and deep aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Calms the mind, aids in spiritual awakening, and is pleasing to Lord Shiva.
ayurvedicBenefit: Excellent for insomnia, depression, and stress relief. Promotes hair growth.
scientificNote: Contains essential oils that have a sedative and neuroprotective effect.
precaution: None

description: Nagarmotha is the dried tuber of the nutgrass plant. Iska upyog havan samagri ko sugandhit banane ke liye hota hai.
havanUse: Provides a woody, earthy, and spicy fragrance to the havan smoke.
spiritualBenefit: Removes negative karma and purifies the subtle body.
ayurvedicBenefit: Improves digestion, reduces fever, and manages obesity.
scientificNote: Has significant anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties.
precaution: None

description: A highly aromatic herb from the Himalayan region. Ye man ko shant karne aur achhi neend ke liye prayog hota hai.
havanUse: Releases a heavy, musky scent that grounds the energy in the ritual space.
spiritualBenefit: Protects from black magic and evil entities.
ayurvedicBenefit: Treats neurological disorders, anxiety, and sleep apnea.
scientificNote: Valerian root acts on GABA receptors in the brain, causing a calming effect.
precaution: Do not consume in large quantities.

description: A potent adaptogenic root smelling faintly of horses. Ye sharirik aur mansik bal badhane wali pramukh aushadhi hai.
havanUse: Burnt in pieces, it adds a robust and slightly bitter aroma to the sacred fire.
spiritualBenefit: Invokes strength, courage, and vitality. Pleasing to Lord Hanuman and Shiva.
ayurvedicBenefit: Reduces stress (cortisol), boosts testosterone, and improves muscle strength.
scientificNote: Rich in withanolides which have powerful anti-stress and anti-tumor effects.
precaution: Avoid consuming during pregnancy without consultation.

description: A creeper herb famous for its memory-enhancing properties. Ye buddhi aur smaran shakti ko tej karti hai.
havanUse: Dried leaves are offered, burning quickly with a mild herbal scent.
spiritualBenefit: Enhances spiritual wisdom (Saraswati kripa) and aids in mastering mantras.
ayurvedicBenefit: Improves memory, concentration, and treats ADHD and Alzheimer's.
scientificNote: Contains bacosides which repair damaged neurons and improve brain function.
precaution: None

description: A plant with conch-shaped flowers, known as a brain tonic. Iska upyog dimag ko thanda rakhne aur vidya prapti ke liye hota hai.
havanUse: Dried flowers and leaves are offered, giving off a subtle fragrance.
spiritualBenefit: Associated with Goddess Saraswati, brings peace of mind and clarity of thought.
ayurvedicBenefit: Relieves mental fatigue, cures insomnia, and improves intellect.
scientificNote: Reduces levels of cortisol and acts as a central nervous system depressant.
precaution: None

description: Giloy is considered 'Amrit' (nectar) in Ayurveda. Ye har tarah ki bimari ko theek karne ki shamta rakhti hai.
havanUse: Dried stems are cut into pieces and offered. Emits a clean, woody scent.
spiritualBenefit: Removes diseases (Rog Nashak) and brings longevity and good health.
ayurvedicBenefit: Immunity booster, treats chronic fevers, diabetes, and purifies blood.
scientificNote: Contains immunomodulatory compounds and is an antioxidant powerhouse.
precaution: May lower blood sugar levels significantly if taken with diabetic medication.

description: Black sesame seeds are deeply sacred to Lord Shani and ancestors. Ye pitru dosh aur shani dosh nivaran ke liye zaruri hain.
havanUse: Popping sound when burned, releases sesame oil smoke which purifies the air.
spiritualBenefit: Appeases ancestors (Pitrus), mitigates Saturn (Shani) afflictions, and removes negative karma.
ayurvedicBenefit: Rich in calcium and iron, improves bone health and hair growth.
scientificNote: High in lignans and phytosterols which help lower cholesterol.
precaution: Produces a lot of smoke when burned in large quantities.

description: White sesame seeds are used in auspicious rituals. Ye devtaon ko prasann karne aur sukh-samriddhi ke liye arpit kiye jate hain.
havanUse: Crackles mildly, producing a pleasant, nutty aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Brings wealth, purity, and is favored by Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi.
ayurvedicBenefit: Excellent for skin health and balancing Vata dosha.
scientificNote: Rich in healthy fats and antioxidants.
precaution: None

description: One of the oldest cultivated grains, considered very pure. Ye havan ka sabse mukhya anaj (anna) hai.
havanUse: Pops and burns quickly, acting as a primary offering (Ahuti) to Agni.
spiritualBenefit: Symbolizes growth, prosperity, and sustains the Devas. Removes poverty.
ayurvedicBenefit: Cooling in nature, helps in weight loss and urinary tract infections.
scientificNote: High in dietary fiber and lowers blood sugar levels.
precaution: Contains gluten (if consumed).

description: Sandalwood is highly revered for its divine fragrance and cooling properties. Ye man ko shant karta hai aur devtaon ko priya hai.
havanUse: Offered as wood chips or powder. Produces a highly sweet, woody, and lingering fragrance.
spiritualBenefit: Purifies the surroundings, attracts divine entities, and brings peace and prosperity.
ayurvedicBenefit: Cools the body, treats skin disorders, and reduces stress.
scientificNote: Alpha-santalol in sandalwood oil has anti-cancer and sedative properties.
precaution: None

description: Known as the 'Wood of the Gods', found in the Himalayas. Iski lakdi havan ko pavitra aur sugandhit banati hai.
havanUse: Burns steadily, releasing a warm, camphor-like, and woody aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Clears negative energy and creates an environment suitable for deep meditation.
ayurvedicBenefit: Treats cough, fever, and skin diseases.
scientificNote: Contains essential oils that are natural insect repellents.
precaution: None

description: Camphor is used for aarti and havan initiation. Ye bina koi raakh chhode jal jata hai, jo ahankar ke nash ka prateek hai.
havanUse: Highly flammable, burns completely with a bright flame and strong, purifying scent.
spiritualBenefit: Destroys ego, wards off negative spirits, and purifies the aura.
ayurvedicBenefit: Clears nasal congestion and relieves joint pain (when applied externally).
scientificNote: Has strong antimicrobial and antiviral properties when sublimated.
precaution: Keep away from children as it is toxic if swallowed in large amounts.

description: An aromatic herb used in perfumery and incense. Iska prayog havan samagri ko aur adhik sugandhit banane ke liye hota hai.
havanUse: Emits a cooling, earthy fragrance when offered in the fire.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts positive energies and pacifies angry deities.
ayurvedicBenefit: Cools the digestive system and treats fever.
scientificNote: Possesses antipyretic and anti-inflammatory properties.
precaution: None

description: Bitter seeds used specifically for healing and tantrik rituals. Ye pet ki bimariyon aur buri shaktiyon ko door karne mein sahayak hai.
havanUse: Burns with a slightly bitter, herbal smell.
spiritualBenefit: Removes planetary doshas, especially related to Rahu and Ketu, and cures black magic.
ayurvedicBenefit: Excellent remedy for diarrhea, dysentery, and diabetes.
scientificNote: Contains alkaloids that are effective against amoebic dysentery.
precaution: Very bitter, avoid chewing.

description: Dried buds of the Mesua ferrea tree. Ye mata Lakshmi ko bahut priya hai aur dhan prapti ke liye chadhaya jata hai.
havanUse: Releases a mild, sweet, and floral fragrance.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts immense wealth, stops unnecessary expenditure, and fulfills desires.
ayurvedicBenefit: Stops bleeding (hemostatic), useful in piles and heavy menstruation.
scientificNote: Has potent astringent and anti-inflammatory properties.
precaution: None

description: One of the three fruits in Triphala. Ye gale aur pet ki bimariyon ke liye uttam hai.
havanUse: Usually crushed before offering. Burns slowly.
spiritualBenefit: Removes obstacles and cures chronic ailments.
ayurvedicBenefit: Excellent for respiratory issues, asthma, and balances Kapha dosha.
scientificNote: Rich in gallic acid and has hepatoprotective effects.
precaution: None

description: Amla is considered a sacred tree and fruit. Ye amarphal mana jata hai aur sehat ke liye sabse achha hai.
havanUse: Dried amla pieces are offered. Emits a slightly tart, fruity smoke.
spiritualBenefit: Brings longevity, youthfulness, and the blessings of Lord Vishnu.
ayurvedicBenefit: Highest natural source of Vitamin C, rejuvenates all bodily tissues.
scientificNote: Potent antioxidant, boosts immunity, and fights free radicals.
precaution: None

description: Known as the 'King of Medicines' in Ayurveda. Ye sabhi rogon ko harne wali divya aushadhi hai.
havanUse: Crushed dried fruit is offered to the fire.
spiritualBenefit: Provides protection, clears karmic baggage, and brings divine grace.
ayurvedicBenefit: Improves digestion, relieves constipation, and balances all three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha).
scientificNote: Increases oxygen levels in the blood and supports gut health.
precaution: Avoid during severe dehydration or pregnancy without advice.

description: Black, kidney-shaped seeds known for treating skin diseases. Iska prayog tantrik aur rog nashak kriyaon mein hota hai.
havanUse: Burns with a strong, pungent odor.
spiritualBenefit: Wards off curses and cures ailments caused by black magic.
ayurvedicBenefit: Renowned for treating vitiligo (leucoderma), psoriasis, and skin conditions.
scientificNote: Contains psoralen, which promotes pigmentation when exposed to UV light.
precaution: Can cause skin blistering if used topically and exposed to intense sun.

description: Aromatic leaves from a Himalayan fir tree. Ye sardi, khansi aur shwas rogon ki achook dawa hai.
havanUse: Leaves burn quickly, releasing a refreshing, pine-like aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Cleanses the aura and brings freshness and positivity to the home.
ayurvedicBenefit: Highly effective for cough, asthma, and clearing the respiratory tract.
scientificNote: Contains essential oils with bronchodilator and expectorant properties.
precaution: None

description: A popular spice with a strong aroma. Jode (pair) mein laung chadhana devi puja mein bahut mahatvapurna hai.
havanUse: Pops violently and burns intensely, releasing a strong, spicy, and purifying smoke.
spiritualBenefit: Fulfills wishes (Manokamna purti), removes negative energy, and appeases Goddess Durga.
ayurvedicBenefit: Relieves toothache, improves digestion, and clears cough.
scientificNote: Rich in eugenol, a natural anesthetic and antibacterial agent.
precaution: None

description: The 'Queen of Spices', known for its sweet aroma. Ye bhagwan ko prasann karne ke liye arpit ki jati hai.
havanUse: Releases a sweet, minty, and uplifting fragrance.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts wealth, luxury, and the blessings of Venus (Shukra) and Lakshmi.
ayurvedicBenefit: Treats bad breath, digestive issues, and acts as a mild stimulant.
scientificNote: Contains compounds that help lower blood pressure.
precaution: None

description: A sweet and spicy tree bark. Ye havan ki sugandh badhane aur rog door karne ke liye prayog hoti hai.
havanUse: Burns easily, emitting a warm, sweet, and comforting woody scent.
spiritualBenefit: Draws positive vibrations, wealth, and success.
ayurvedicBenefit: Regulates blood sugar, boosts metabolism, and treats colds.
scientificNote: Contains cinnamaldehyde, which has potent anti-diabetic and antimicrobial effects.
precaution: None

description: Mango wood is the base for most Hindu havan fires. Ye jaldi aag pakadti hai aur pavitra mani jati hai.
havanUse: Serves as the primary Samidha (firewood). Burns clearly with minimal irritating smoke.
spiritualBenefit: Invites auspiciousness and is acceptable to all Devas. Purifies the air effectively.
ayurvedicBenefit: The smoke acts as a natural air purifier and mosquito repellent.
scientificNote: When burned at high temperatures, it releases formaldehyde gas in minute quantities, which kills airborne bacteria.
precaution: Ensure the wood is completely dry to avoid excessive smoke.

description: Palash wood and flowers are used in specific rituals. Ye chandra dosh shanti aur vidya prapti ke liye mahatvapurna hai.
havanUse: Wood is used as Samidha, especially for Moon (Chandra) related rituals.
spiritualBenefit: Appeases the Moon god, brings mental peace, and aids in acquiring knowledge.
ayurvedicBenefit: Treats skin diseases, intestinal worms, and diabetes.
scientificNote: Flowers contain bright yellow pigments used as natural dyes (e.g., in Holi).
precaution: None

description: Peepal tree is believed to be the abode of the Trinity (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva). Iski samidha guru dosh nivaran ke liye prayog hoti hai.
havanUse: Dry twigs are used as offering. Burns well.
spiritualBenefit: Pacifies Jupiter (Guru) doshas, brings wisdom, and blesses with progeny.
ayurvedicBenefit: Bark and leaves treat asthma, wound healing, and heart diseases.
scientificNote: Peepal tree releases a large amount of oxygen, even at night (CAM photosynthesis).
precaution: Never cut a green Peepal tree for wood; use naturally fallen dry twigs.

description: Neem is a powerful purifying agent. Ye nakaratmak urja, rog aur shani/ketu dosh door karne ke liye prayog hoti hai.
havanUse: Neem wood and leaves are burned, releasing a slightly bitter, antibacterial smoke.
spiritualBenefit: Destroys enemies (internal and external), cures diseases, and pleases Goddess Kali.
ayurvedicBenefit: Purifies blood, treats severe skin conditions, and boosts immunity.
scientificNote: Contains azadirachtin, a potent natural insecticide and antimicrobial.
precaution: Smoke can be slightly bitter to inhale.

description: The most sacred plant in Hinduism, dear to Lord Vishnu. Iski lakdi aur patte moksha dayak mane jate hain.
havanUse: Dried stems (manjari) and leaves are offered. Emits a very pleasant, sweet, and purifying aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Grants spiritual purity, peace, and moksha. Essential for Vishnu and Krishna worship.
ayurvedicBenefit: Excellent for cough, cold, fever, and respiratory ailments.
scientificNote: Rich in ursolic acid and eugenol, providing strong adaptogenic and antibacterial benefits.
precaution: Avoid offering Tulsi in Lord Ganesha and Shiva havans.

description: Trifoliate leaves sacred to Lord Shiva. Ye teen gunon (Sattva, Rajas, Tamas) ka prateek hain.
havanUse: Dried leaves and fruit pieces are offered into the fire.
spiritualBenefit: Destroys sins of three births, highly pleasing to Lord Shiva, brings immense wealth (when offering Bilva fruit).
ayurvedicBenefit: Bael fruit cures diarrhea and dysentery; leaves regulate blood sugar.
scientificNote: Has anti-ulcer and hypoglycemic properties.
precaution: Leaves should not be torn while offering.

description: Black seeds from the lotus flower. Ye Mata Lakshmi ko atyant priya hain aur dhan prapti ke liye upayogi hain.
havanUse: Offered whole or dipped in ghee or honey. Popping sound when burned.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts permanent wealth, clears financial debts, and pleases Goddess Lakshmi.
ayurvedicBenefit: Cooling effect, stops bleeding, and improves female reproductive health.
scientificNote: Rich in protein and beneficial minerals like potassium and phosphorus.
precaution: Hard shell may cause them to pop out of the fire if not coated in ghee.

description: Whole, unbroken rice grains used as a symbol of completeness. Ye har puja ka mukhya hissa hain.
havanUse: Mixed with sesame, barley, and ghee as the primary Ahuti.
spiritualBenefit: Brings completeness, prosperity, and peace. Represents the unblemished soul.
ayurvedicBenefit: Provides instant energy and is easily digestible (when eaten).
scientificNote: Staple carbohydrate source; burning rice provides fuel to the fire.
precaution: Rice grains must not be broken (Khandit) for puja purposes.

description: A mix of 5 dry fruits (almonds, cashews, raisins, dry dates, makhana) offered as Prasad and Ahuti.
havanUse: Offered into the fire to symbolize offering the best, most nourishing food to Devas.
spiritualBenefit: Represents offering of wealth and sweetness, brings abundance and blessings.
ayurvedicBenefit: Highly nutritious, builds strength, immunity, and stamina.
scientificNote: Packed with healthy fats, vitamins, and antioxidants.
precaution: Burns quickly, creating a sweet, caramelized smoke.

description: Dry coconut used as the final offering in a havan. Ye aham (ego) ke samarpan ka prateek hai.
havanUse: Stuffed with ghee, sugar, and navgraha samagri, then offered into the fire during Purna Ahuti.
spiritualBenefit: Symbolizes the complete surrender of ego and the successful completion of the ritual.
ayurvedicBenefit: Rich in healthy fats; oil is good for hair and skin.
scientificNote: Highly combustible due to high oil content, feeds the fire intensely at the end of the ritual.
usedInRituals: Purna Ahuti (Final Offering in all havans)
precaution: Burns very fiercely; maintain safe distance from the Havan Kund.

description: A fragrant seed used as a spice and medicinal herb. Ye vishesh manokamna purti ke liye chadhaya jata hai.
havanUse: Offered whole or crushed. Emits a warm, sweet, and spicy aroma.
spiritualBenefit: Offered for fulfilling specific strong desires, overcoming enemies, and in tantrik rituals.
ayurvedicBenefit: Induces sleep, treats diarrhea, and improves skin tone.
scientificNote: Contains myristicin, a natural compound that affects the central nervous system.
precaution: Toxic in large doses if consumed.

description: The lacy outer covering of the nutmeg seed. Ye havan mein sugandh aur shanti ke liye prayog hoti hai.
havanUse: Burns very quickly, releasing a delicate, sweet, and spicy fragrance.
spiritualBenefit: Attracts peace, harmony in relationships, and divine blessings.
ayurvedicBenefit: Aids digestion, boosts appetite, and improves blood circulation.
scientificNote: Rich in essential oils like macelignan, providing anti-inflammatory benefits.
precaution: None
